property_summary: For all calls to version() the reference contract returns the non-empty string "1.0.0" (i.e., a non-empty bytes length), whereas the mutant returns an empty string for some inputs, so the general rule is: version() must return a non-empty string; the bug breaks this by returning the empty string for at least some call.
change_summary: Change the returned version string from "1.0.0" to an empty string "".
mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return ""; }
